title: DIMASSOC DXF intersection-object edge fast slice
mode: local implementation with generated in-memory tests
scope: Preserve DIMASSOC intersection object handle group 332 and documented groups 74/92
Route the intersection handle through existing DXF reference remapping and emitted-entity closure
Keep unqualified XREF and DWG body semantics fail-closed
Use focused ASCII/Binary validation without external sample fixtures

method.kind: Generated in-memory ASCII/Binary DXF round-trip and emitted-graph controls
method.limitations: This is a partial typed DXF DIMASSOC subset. It does not establish live associative updates, complete DIMASSOC semantics, XREF-reference roles, or DWG DIMASSOC layout.

sources.observed: The table defines group 72 osnap type values including intersection (6) and apparent intersection (11); group 332 is the intersection geometry object ID; groups 74 and 92 are its subentity type and GS marker; group 302 is an intersection XREF handle string; group 75 is the last-point flag.

The implementation sequence requires preservation/refusal for unmodeled fields, exact output graph closure for references, no inferred DWG byte layout, focused per-slice verification, and no fixture additions from external repositories.

implementation.model: DRW_DimensionAssociationOsnapRef now has presence/value fields for intersection object handle, subentity type, and GS marker. Parser detects duplicate/orphan 74/92/332 values; XREF groups 301/302 remain guarded.
implementation.writer: Groups 332/74/92 are emitted in Autodesk order. Group 332 uses the same resolver/remapper and emitted-entity graph check as group 331. Types 6/11 require nonzero main-object group 331 and intersection-object group 332 handles; non-intersection types reject intersection-only fields; group 74 is range-checked as signed 16-bit.
implementation.dwgBoundary: The DWG encoder refuses all newly modeled intersection-only DXF fields before bytes; no DWG parser or wire-format code changed.
implementation.apiImpact: Public osnap-reference structure layout changed; downstream consumers must rebuild and no ABI compatibility is claimed.
